prefill_tok_s.why: prefill is 294/314.33 s of a real agent turn

decode_tok_s.why: decode is 20/314.33 s of a real agent turn

decode_agg_tok_s.why: decode is 20/314.33 s of a real agent turn

chat_turn_wall_s.why: the turn wall is the 314.33 s denominator itself; reuse moves it 19x

prefix_hits.why: instrument row for the reuse view, not a lever itself

ssd_restart_speedup.why: a restart re-pays the prefill 94%; the tier is what avoids it

train_step_tok_s.why: seconds_per_step of time_to_score = steps x seconds; the split is unmeasured, so 0.5 until it is

gsm8k_pct.why: the RL line's acceptance verdict; the README's headline training number (89.6 to 94.8)

rollout_tokens.why: mean completion tokens per GSM8K problem — the sample-efficiency operand, n-independent by construction. tokens/correct is the view rollout_tokens / gsm8k_pct, never stored

mmlu_pct.why: correctness floor, not a speed lever

spec_goodput_ratio.why: decode-family; a guard row after the verdict flipped three times

kernel_ms.why: feeds the engine-level rows; micro, not a lever itself

request_overhead_ms.why: per-request HTTP+render+parse over a canned engine; not the agent-turn wall clock (that is chat_turn_wall_s), so weight 0 until it is shown to move the turn
